title: Live Updates: Investigators Seek to Establish Motive in FlyDubai Attack
summary_full: The United Arab Emirates said it would lead the investigation, including into possible links to terrorism. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the attacker had undergone “Islamist radical indoctrination,” though he did not elaborate.
